results.name: Gold ring
results.description:
**Collection:** Prehistory and Historical Archeology Dept.

**Inv.-No.:** [UF-19884.377](https://www.online.landessammlungen-noe.at/objects/1009549)

**Material:** Gold

**Dimensions:** 1,43 x 2,36 cm

**Dating:** 150-350 CE

The piece of jewellery under consideration is a large gold ring in the shape of two intertwined snakes.
The ring was crafted in a distinctive meandering shape and featured snake heads at the ends as decorative embellishments. The presence of small knots is observable at the points where the meanders intersect. The scales of the plastic snake heads have been meticulously crafted to display a realism in their appearance. In the area where the ocular cavities should be located, it is presumed that gemstones or glass were inserted.

This object was digitized through the ‘Kulturerbe digital’ program of the Federal Ministry for Arts, Culture, Public Service and Sport.

results.name: Silver Ring (NHMW-PRAE-SH419c-02)
results.description:
3D model of a silver ring that forms part of a precious jewelry set in Suebian/Germanic style from a woman’s grave presumably found at Mount Oberleis in Lower Austria, just north of the boundary of the former Roman Empire. Germanic tribes settled there at the time when close to the military fort of Carnuntum the ["Heidentor" (aka "Heathens' Gate", Austria’s contribution to Europeana Twin it!)](https://kulturpool.at/inhalte/die-europaeische-kampagne-twin-it-zur-3d-digitalisierung) was erected during the reign of the roman emperor, Constantinus II. These tribes were often allied with the Romans south of the Danube and strongly influenced by their culture.

On display in Hall 13 of the NHM Vienna.

**Object**: Silver ring

**Inventory number:** NHMW-PRAE-SH419c-02

**Collection:** NHM Vienna, Department of Prehistory (curator: Stefan Eichert)

[More about the NHM Vienna](www.nhm.at)

Digitized using microCT imaging (YXLON FF35 CT) and edited in ORS Dragonfly and Blender by Viola Winkler (NHMW)

results.name: Stylized Ring for 3D Print & Render
results.description:
A decorative ring model created in Blender, ideal for use in stylized projects, concept renders, or as a gift after 3D printing.

💍 Not scaled: The model is not set to a specific finger size. Please adjust it to your needs before printing.

💎 No gemstone included: The ring is designed without a gemstone. A jewel or decorative stone can be glued onto the top surface after printing.

🎮 Not Game-Ready:
This model is not optimized for real-time engines or game use. It’s intended for static display and 3D printing only.

results.name: Staff or Magic Lamp Fantasy Free Model
results.description:
Staff Fantasy Free Model.

This was just testing some emissions and transparency in Substance Painter. The rings and orb are glass with emission. You can go into the model details and adjust the emissions of the "orb" and "rings". The emission is currently set at 8 for a good display in Sketchfab. Setting emissions to 1.0 will give it a true glowing glass. 

This emission is strong enough to remove the color of the glass currently. So if you take this into Blender. Go to the textures and raise emissions if you want to recreate this brighter glow. Or leave it as is for an overall better look. The glass is a pretty purple with a blue glow but it just doesn't display here as well.

Free.
cc0.

results.name: Realistic Pitbull Fighting Ring Diorama
results.description:
Realistic miniature fighting ring diorama featuring a pitbull arena scene, created as a detailed display piece and optimized for high-resolution resin 3D printing. This model was developed using a hybrid workflow combining AI-assisted generation, digital sculpting, and manual kitbashing refinement in Blender.

The scene focuses on grounded realism, natural proportions, and believable surface wear, including aged materials, environmental detail, and miniature-scale storytelling. Geometry has been cleaned and optimized to preserve sculpted detail while maintaining reliable printability.

Suitable for collectors, miniature painters, and diorama builders looking for realistic scene compositions and display-ready models.

Workflow: AI generation → sculpt cleanup → kitbash refinement → topology optimization → print preparation.

Created by Inked3D — , AI kitbashing, and realistic printable miniatures.
